title: STOP asking AI to sound human
description:
Stop asking AI to “sound more human.”

That usually leads to generic, polished, vaguely corporate writing.

A better move: train AI to sound like you.

Give it real examples of how you communicate: emails, blog posts,
transcripts, keynote notes, client messages, or content you’ve already
written. Then ask it to extract your tone, structure, phrasing, and
communication patterns into a reusable style guide.

That markdown file becomes a voice layer you can plug into your
chatbot, agent system, or content workflow so the output feels
consistent with how you actually think and speak.

AI works better when you stop chasing “human” and start giving it real context.

#AIForBusiness #PromptEngineering #AITools #PersonalBranding #ContentStrategy
